subject: general
question:
Refer to the number series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(NOTE: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 2 1 6 9 1 9 6 4 2 4 4 6 7 6 4 1 8 7 9 2 4 4 7 6 8 7 2 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 2 1 6 9 1 9 6 4 2 4 4 6 7 6 4 1 8 7 9 2 4 4 7 6 8 7 2 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Even — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f346459185bf1f97dd70106d557f42dd13084b3f27791c97d489d095c464ba8.png] 

Thus, there are 2 even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
